title: Scania FUPS powder coated Bullbar #17
description: Scania Heavy duty powder-coated high tensile aluminium FUPS Bullbar with extended uprights to lower heavy duty cow catcher bar. Heavy duty tow pin and driving light mounts as required. Choice of colours for powder-coating. Choice of 76 or 88mm pipe. 100mm pipe on request. The bull bar can be custom built to your specification. Eye bolt base plate fitted to channel to protect powder coating
